title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust isn't just a benchmark—it's a protocol that ensures safe, reliable navigation through verified environmental models and ethical AI behavior.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential to evaluate performance across diverse scenarios, without bias—NavTrust’s protocol is too rigid for real-world unpredictability.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates real-world data from MIT and Stanford, ensuring models are tested on actual human behaviors and edge cases, not just simulated ones.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking allows for transparency and comparison—NavTrust’s closed protocol limits innovation by locking researchers into a single framework.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust may be secure, but without open benchmarking, we can’t measure progress or trust the claims of its developers.
